'''Ro-tuK''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] of the [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Upon the reappearance of the ancient Gree starship ''[[Gray Secant]]'', Ro-tuK invited members from both sides of the war to come to [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] to assist the Gree in their experiments.<ref name="GEX" /><ref name="GRI" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ro-tuK first appeared in game update 1.7 of the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2013]]. He is only accessible through the Relics of the Gree event to both factions in the game.
